Shabir Ran Mein Tanha Sab Ko Bula Rahe Hain.
Jhole Mein Sun Ke Asghar Khud Ko Gira Rahe Hain.

1
Ro Kar Sakina Bolin Bhiyya Zara Thehar Ja.
Pani Ki Mashk Ammo Darya Se La Rahe Hain.
Teyar Kar Ke Maa Ne Godi Mein De Diya Hai.
Asghar Ko Le Ke Mula Maidaan Ko Ja Rahe Hain.

2
Sokhi Zabaan Se Aisa Ik War Kar Diya Hai.
Munh Phair Phair Zalim Aanso Baha Rahe Hain.
Dada Ki Milkiyat Mein Jis Ke Hoz-e-Kausar.
Afsos Oss Pe Zalim Paikaan Chala Rahe Hain.

3
Asghar Ka Khon-e-Na Haq Chulo Mein Le Mula.
ALLAH Ke Ghazab Se Sab Ko Bacha Rahe Hain.
Thamtay Nahi Hain Aanso Ab Aankh Se Hasan Ki.
Majlis Mein Loag Khali Jhola Utha Rahe Hain.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/shabir-ran-mein-tanha-sab-ko-bula-rahe-hain-tajpoints-de58e4c83fad30724442.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, digits in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    sections = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    rows = [s.strip().splitlines() for s in sections]
    assert [len(r) for r in rows] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
    assert [r[0].strip() for r in rows[1:]] == list(digits)
assert all(not line or line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines())
assert '\\u200c' not in body and 'noUrdu' not in meta
print('Verified 14 verses in each edition, with a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas.

Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. Rendered “Ammo” as عمّو and “Chulo” as چلّو. Only the selected lyric was edited.
